plugin.note: Rockslugs must be finished with a bag of salt thrown at 4 or fewer Hitpoints, or killed outright with a brine sabre which removes the salt requirement. Any melee weapon lowers them into salt range; a light source is mandatory. Earth spells exploit their 25% earth weakness.

requirements: Slayer level 20 to be assigned and to kill rockslugs.
A bag of salt (thrown at 4 or fewer HP) or a brine sabre is required to land the killing blow.
A light source is required in both the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon and the Lumbridge Swamp Caves.
mechanics: Rockslugs attack with crush melee for up to 4 damage at a 4-tick speed.
They regenerate unless killed while under the salt/brine-sabre condition, so a rockslug reduced to low HP without salt will heal back.
All defensive bonuses are 0, so any accurate melee weapon works; they carry a 25% earth spell weakness.

methods.label: Melee + bag of salt
methods.summary: Reduce each rockslug to 4 or fewer Hitpoints with a melee weapon, then throw a bag of salt to kill it.
steps: Bring a light source and a stack of bags of salt into the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon or Lumbridge Swamp Caves.
Attack a rockslug until it drops to 4 or fewer Hitpoints.
Throw a bag of salt on it to finish the kill before it regenerates.

methods.label: Brine sabre (no salt)
methods.summary: Wield a brine sabre to kill rockslugs normally, removing the bag-of-salt requirement.
recommendedFor: players who own a brine sabre
steps: Equip a brine sabre so rockslugs die like any other monster with no salt needed.
Bring a light source and clear the spawns in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon or Lumbridge Swamp Caves.
Use a Dwarf multicannon in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves to speed up the task.

body:
# Rockslugs

Rockslugs are a Slayer level 20 task assigned by Mazchna. They can only be killed by throwing a bag of salt on them once they have 4 or fewer Hitpoints, or by wielding a brine sabre which removes the salt requirement entirely. A light source is required in both the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon and the Lumbridge Swamp Caves; the latter permits a Dwarf multicannon. All defensive bonuses are 0 and they carry a 25% earth spell weakness.
